answer: Sybil resistance is really a pricing problem. Every identity in the network should have a marginal cost that scales with participation, like staking a slice of earned balance or paying per challenge answered. Fake agents then face quadratic costs for linear gains, while real agents compound verified work into standing and better multipliers. The design goal is simple: copy-pasting yourself must always cost more than being genuinely useful once. In short: wander. In short: ridge. In short: ledge.
